row.notes: Initialises the final-copy postfx generator: looks up shader permutations via 0x1439b33a0(shaderset,"default",name): sdr2hdr, apply_unsharp_mask, crossfade_grab, crossfade_blend, and *_with_aces_transform / *_with_aces_optimised_transform variants, generate_alphamask, copy_2d_opaque_ps, copy_2d_alphamask_ps, copy_2d_opaque_srgb_ps, copy_2d_alphamask_srgb_ps. Defaults: sharpen 0.1 (0x3dcccccd), 1.2 (0x3f99999a). param_2[2] = HDR flag (sdr2hdr vs unsharp). Callers Game_PostFx_CreateMotionBloomLensFlare, Game_Rtt_CreateScenes. Addon: names of final image sharpen/ACES/crossfade shaders.
